column1: # Telluric absorption lines: air wavelengths in the topocentric frame
# Measured for albireo from the median of 43 PEPSI red-arm (cross-disperser 5) spectra of five
# (-SSBVEL) undone so that the telluric lines are at rest. The median over stars at different
# velocities keeps the telluric lines and suppresses the stellar ones. Each minimum deeper than
# 0.02 was fitted with a Gaussian on a linear continuum within +-14 km/s.
# depth and fwhm_kms are those of the median spectrum (PEPSI LSF FWHM 6.77 km/s
# centre_err_kms is the formal error of the fitted centre; isolated = 1 when no other line
# deeper than 0.05 lies within 15 km/s. Kept: depth >= 0.05
# centre_err_kms <= 0.15. band: O2 for 6270-6330 and 6860-6950 A
# Validation: the zero points of 93 APF exposures measured against a spectrum built from this
# list agree with those measured against the full median spectrum to 0.031 km/s rms
